neighbours.label: The comma right after a ONE-word linking or comment adverb that opens a sentence (However, Therefore, Meanwhile, Indeed, Unfortunately); quiet for the same word mid-sentence, for time/place/manner openers (Today, Outside, Slowly), names, clause openers, list commas, and for the odd openers Still, Besides, Well; multi-word openers (As a result, In addition) are unreliable
fire: However, the bridge was closed for repairs by the time we arrived.
The team trained hard all season. Therefore, nobody was surprised when they won the final.
Meanwhile, the soup on the stove had started to boil over.
Indeed, the old map turned out to be far more accurate than the new one.
Unfortunately, the train to Lyon had already left the station.
She had studied the problem for weeks. Consequently, her answer came quickly.
Moreover, the new policy reduces paperwork for small businesses.
Nevertheless, the hikers pressed on toward the summit.
quiet: The bridge, however, was closed for repairs by the time we arrived.
The team trained hard all season, and nobody was surprised when they won the final.
Outside, the soup vendors had started to pack up their carts.
Today, the old map turned out to be far more accurate than the new one.
Slowly, the train to Lyon pulled out of the station.
She had studied the problem for weeks. Still, her answer came slowly.
Besides, the new policy reduces paperwork for small businesses.
Well, the hikers pressed on toward the summit anyway.
neighbours.short: comma after a one-word sentence-opening connective (However, / Indeed,)
neighbours.notes: Test sentences written blind by a second author who saw only the label. Probes: one-word connective/comment openers at sentence start read 0.19-0.42 (Indeed 0.42, Afterwards 0.42, Hence 0.40); same word mid-sentence 0.02; Today/Outside/After lunch/In Paris/Because-clause/names/list commas <= 0.06; Still/Besides/Well ~0.005. Inverse solver (differential evolution): no leak; silent on-concept text was the multi-word 'As a result,' (0.06). play step (zero ablation) ran out of GPU memory, so TARGET was chosen from the resident attribution feeders ranking (strongest unmapped MLP feeder of L13/N7743-); no ablation edge weight recorded.

predictions: most fire sentences 0.2-0.4 (risk: text-initial openers may read lower); near misses near zero
